certificate_requirements: For barangay certificates, you'll typically need: Valid ID, Proof of residency, and payment of processing fees. Specific requirements vary by certificate type.
Certificate requirements usually include government-issued ID, residency proof, and applicable fees. Let me check what specific certificate you're interested in.
Basic requirements for most certificates: 1) Valid ID, 2) Proof of address/residency, 3) Processing fee. Would you like details for a specific certificate?
certificate_processing: Processing times vary: Barangay Clearance (1-2 days), Residency Certificate (same day), Indigency Certificate (1-3 days), Business Permit (3-5 days).
Most certificates are processed within 1-3 business days. Rush processing is available for additional fees.
Certificate processing typically takes 1-5 business days depending on the type. You can check status by visiting the barangay hall.
certificate_validity: Barangay certificates are generally valid for 6-12 months. Clearance is valid for 1 year, while others may vary.
Certificate validity depends on type: Clearance (1 year), Residency (6 months), Indigency (6 months), Business permits (1 year).
Most certificates need renewal annually. Check the expiration date and renew before it expires to avoid complications.
blotter_reporting: To report an incident: Visit barangay hall during office hours, fill out the blotter form, and provide details. The barangay will investigate and mediate.
For blotter reports: Go to barangay hall, complete the incident report form, and provide witness information if available. All reports are handled confidentially.
Incident reporting: Visit the barangay secretary during office hours with your complaint details. They'll guide you through the blotter filing process.
blotter_process: After filing a blotter: Barangay assigns a case number, conducts initial investigation within 3 days, schedules mediation, and works toward resolution.
Blotter process: 1) Case filing, 2) Investigation, 3) Mediation session, 4) Resolution or escalation. Most cases are resolved through barangay mediation.
Once filed, the barangay will investigate, attempt mediation between parties, and document the resolution. Serious cases may be forwarded to police.
identification: For barangay ID: Must be registered resident (6+ months), bring 2x2 photo, valid ID for verification, and ₱20 processing fee.
Barangay ID requirements: 6-month residency, 2x2 photo, government ID, ₱20 fee. Valid for 3 years.
To get barangay ID: Register as resident, provide photo and valid ID, pay processing fee. Required for many barangay services.
office_hours: Barangay office hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM. Closed Sundays and holidays.
We're open Monday to Friday 8 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday 8 AM to 12 PM. Emergency services available 24/7.
Regular hours: Weekdays 8-5, Saturday 8-12. For emergencies, contact our 24/7 hotline.

Reach us at: Phone (02) 123-4567, Email: barangay@batia.gov.ph, Facebook: Barangay Batia Official. Emergency hotline: 0917-123-4567.

social_services: We provide assistance for seniors, PWDs, and single parents including medical aid, financial support, and special programs.
Social services available: Senior citizen benefits, PWD assistance, single parent support, medical aid, and educational grants.
Various social programs: Medical assistance, financial aid for vulnerable groups, counseling, job training, and emergency relief.
emergency_services: Emergency contacts: Police (117), Fire (160), Medical emergencies (911). Barangay tanod patrol available 24/7.
For emergencies: Call 911 for medical, 160 for fire, 117 for police. Barangay provides 24/7 security patrol and coordination.
Emergency services: 24/7 barangay tanod, fire coordination, medical emergency response, and police assistance when needed.
community_events: Community events include health seminars, clean-up drives, sports tournaments, cultural festivals, and senior programs.
We organize monthly health seminars, weekly clean-up drives, sports events, cultural activities, and regular community assemblies.
Upcoming events: Health awareness programs, environmental activities, youth development camps, and senior citizen gatherings.
lost_documents: For lost documents: File affidavit of loss, provide valid ID, pay ₱25 processing fee. New document issued within 3-5 days.
Lost document replacement: Submit affidavit of loss with valid ID and processing fee. Replacement issued within 3-5 business days.
To replace lost documents: File loss affidavit, show valid identification, pay replacement fee. Processing takes 3-5 days.
waste_management: Waste collection: Monday-Wednesday-Friday schedule. Segregate biodegradable and non-biodegradable waste. ₱50 quarterly fee.
Garbage collection on M-W-F. Please separate waste types. Quarterly fee ₱50. Special collection available for bulky items.
Waste disposal: Regular collection M-W-F, waste segregation required, ₱50 quarterly fee, eco-friendly programs available.
